sandboxBadge: PayPal sandbox · no real money moves
title: Pick a plan, pay once
intro: Buy a plan with a PayPal sandbox buyer account, then ask the chat in the corner about your payment, such as a refund. The AI checks that you really paid and refunds small amounts within the store's limits.
demoStore: This is Feedloop's own demo store. Purchases run in the PayPal sandbox, and the plans aren't real products.
notSetUp: The demo store isn't available right now. Please check back later.
footnote: Prices are placeholders. Everything here runs in the PayPal sandbox, and no real money moves.

captured.title: Payment received
captured.body: Thank you! Your payment went through.

approved.title: Payment processing
approved.body: PayPal is still processing this payment. This page updates when it completes.

created.title: Waiting for PayPal
created.body: This order hasn't been approved on PayPal yet. This page updates on its own.

failed.title: Payment declined
failed.body: PayPal declined the payment. Nothing was charged.

partially_refunded.title: Partially refunded
partially_refunded.body: Part of this payment went back to you through PayPal. The rest still stands. Refunds usually reach your PayPal account within a few days.

refunded.title: Payment refunded
refunded.body: This payment was refunded through PayPal. Refunds usually show up in your PayPal account within a few days.

reversed.title: Payment reversed
reversed.body: PayPal reversed this payment (for example, after a dispute), and the money went back to you. This plan is no longer paid.

receipt.questions: Questions about this payment? Open the chat in the corner and include your PayPal order ID and the email you paid with.
